title: ctenopteris undosa
intro: Ctenopteris undosa, commonly known as the 'Parsley fern', is a type of fern found in the tropical regions of Australia and the Pacific Islands. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ctenopteris undosa include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve inflammation, and reduce fever, while also providing antioxidant properties to protect against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
